recoveredFacts: All thirty owner and thirty token skill ranks retain their complete original blackboards. S1 is automatic time recovery and recharges a mine; S2 is manual attack recovery for twenty seconds; S3 is manual time recovery with forty rounds and manual deactivation.

The original GRZMOT root prohibits tiles occupied by walking enemies, requires no facing and does not restrict placement to host attack range. Its selected promotion table retains separate maxDeployCount and maxDeckStackCnt fields, and Talent1 retains the selected cnt value including its potential upgrade. Initial stock, simultaneous placement limits and recharge execution await controller review.

Mine trigger selectors retain walking-enemy filters, one trigger target and a distinct area selector. The mine starts with a 0.3-second clip and its Attack event is approximately 0.167 seconds into a 0.333-second clip. Native birth/selection/event execution still requires runtime review.

S1 mines apply database sluggish and separate Physical/Arts hit-rate penalties with an ela_token_influence marker. S2 mines apply stun and the same marker. S3 mines apply sluggish, the marker and database weak[limit]; none of the token active-buff lists contains direct damage.

Talent2 checks ela_token_influence without checking the buff source or source host, then applies the selected attack multiplier; otherwise it uses the selected probability. Original ordinary and cached-projectile calculation hooks remain separate, so roll timing must be reviewed rather than inferred from animation.

S2 uses its own skill range, DEF increase, fixed DEF penetration and projectile area blackboard. S3 uses its own attack interval/ATK values, target priority, forty-round resource and manual finish controller. Their serialized mode/finishing fields remain complete.

Owner death and withdrawal are different native paths. ON_OWNER_KILLED sets Boomed and invokes DeadBoom; ON_OWNER_FINISH invokes WithdrawBoom only if that marker is zero. Death projectiles retain an approximately 0.8-second delay and 0.9-second lifetime; withdrawal projectiles have zero delay and 0.1-second lifetime. Owner finish also kills owned tokens.

Both original owner skeleton pointer chains are byte-verified against the pinned model repository. The original base mine is extracted through its native token animator, single skeleton, atlas, material and RGBA texture, with two intentional facing aliases; it is not the alternate skin available in the model repository.
holdReasons: Complete mine placement, selected stock/capacity, trigger area, status/marker lifetime, skill-end recharge and owner-finish output must be integrated and tested before playable registration.

Ordinary and cached-projectile talent rolls, S2 splash/penetration and S3 ammunition/target priority need source-fed controllers with interruption, finish and redeployment cleanup. Serialized fields do not establish compiled FSM/frame parity.
No partial skill or asset-only import counts as complete operator support; modules, original particles/audio and native same-frame execution remain unfinished.
